messages:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up  short handbook edit: clarify manager-facing language for schedule exceptions (keep contractor language as 'recommended'). Need two quick reviewers + one person to run RSVP/completion tracking. Target publish 2026-06-15.

Omar: I can do a wording pass today. Will keep it concise.

June (Legal): I'll review EU/DE clauses. Quick flag: DE needs a documented expected duration if remote > 10 business days.

Aria (Localization): Avoid idioms like 'flex credits' or 'comp days' and we'll translate quickly.

Tess: I can own the tracker and automations (RSVP + completion receipts). Share CSV header pls.

Rae (People Ops): CSV header (exact order, use when adding rows):
```csv
manager_name,team,email,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,session,verifier,notes
```
We rely on the ordering for nightly exports.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled  RSVP ping 7 days before first session; completion nudge 48h before publish date.

Omar: Wording pass done  renamed the section to "Manager-authorized schedule exceptions" and added a one-sentence example about short-term on-call swaps.

June (Legal): Reviewed. Added the DE sentence and tightened contractor wording. No blockers.

Aria (Localization): Ready to translate once final text is posted.

Tess: I'll seed the tracker with managers from Eng/Product and set up auto-PDF receipts to the email column. Will also export nightly to s3://compliance/handbook-acks.

Rae (People Ops): Action items: 1) Omar finalize wording today; 2) June legal sign-off by 2026-06-01; 3) Tess build tracker + automations by 2026-06-05; 4) Aria localize after freeze; 5) Rae publish 2026-06-15 and run two 20-min drop-ins (2026-06-08 & 2026-06-12). PR link to follow.

PeopleOpsBot: Note: managers must use the exact CSV header ordering for clean exports and SLAs.

Rae (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/2026-manager-schedule-exceptions. Please leave quick reviews. Thanks! :raised_hands:
